<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 183.045 corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.0378 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1) suggests ~9–10 carbons, and the best matching monoisotopic formula is C₉H₁₀O₂S (exact mass 182.0402 Da, within typical instrument tolerance). This fits the observed peaks and the required output format.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O2S</final_answer>
